content.content:
Discarding a draft forgets the draft's jj workspace and removes its directory under the one per-user draft-workspace root, and an absence at either point is the same discard carried through rather than a failure. This is one commitment because it is one question asked of one object: what does the end of a draft do to the workspace the draft was written in? The workspace is jj's object and the record names it by name and path as a reference (xqzstoyo, vuopwuyo), so the discard asks jj to give the workspace up, clears the tree that stands at the path the record's handle derives, and tolerates either being already gone because a drifted draft is still an open draft and ending it is a discard like any other (tvxspkyy, vuopwuyo). Nothing here decides what becomes of the record document, what becomes of the change, or how any of it is invoked.

The forget goes through the workspace seam and takes jj's answer as the answer. jj owns whether a draft's workspace exists — the workspace is jj's object while the registry holds only the reference that names it — so a discard cannot decide for itself that the workspace is there, and it does not read the directory to guess; it asks for the workspace the record refers to and reads what jj says (vuopwuyo, xqzstoyo). That crossing already has an owner: the workspace module's forget checks the name against the enumeration first, because jj exits zero with only a warning for a name it does not know, and carries an absent name as Unknown with nothing removed rather than reporting a silent success (tyoypkmp). The discard therefore performs the forget as that seam performs it: a completed forget is jj dropping the workspace, and Unknown is jj holding no workspace of that name, so nothing was dropped. The crossing is named here only as the operation a discard performs; the exact jj invocation, its arguments and its flags stay the seam's (tyoypkmp). The registry itself creates and removes no workspace of its own (vuopwuyo); the forget is the discard's own crossing, not a registry rule. And the forget crosses into jj's state, not into the graph: it writes no node, no change and no marker, so it is not one of the three operations and it opens no bracket (tvxspkyy). The workspace half adds no registry write and no graph write: the record's leaving stays the store's removal, so the only registry change a discard makes remains that removal, and the forget and the directory removal sit outside the registry, where the workspace mechanics were left open (tvxspkyy).

The directory is removed at the path the derivation fixes, after the forget and not before. That path is the per-user draft-workspace root outside the repository, then the repository's own namespace under that root, then the record's handle, with nothing appended (xqzstoyo, tyoypkmp). The derivation is what makes the directory knowable even when the workspace is gone: a drifted record still names the workspace it refers to and still carries the handle, and the handle yields the same path with no repository-local lookup and no other draft consulted (vuopwuyo, xqzstoyo). Only that directory is removed — not the namespace directory above it, not the root, and no path beyond the handle and the name the record carries. The order belongs to the same answer rather than standing beside it: jj owns whether the workspace exists (vuopwuyo), so the tree is cleared only once jj no longer holds it, because removing the tree first would strip a working copy out from under a workspace jj still claims, and forgetting afterwards would leave jj's claim standing over a path whose tree is gone. Forget first makes the directory a tree no workspace holds; then it is removed.

An absence at either point is tolerated as the same discard, and tolerated as an absence rather than as a success. This is one tolerance and not a policy per step: the rule is that the end of a draft does not require the workspace to have survived to either crossing, because the draft is ended whether or not it did. There are two steps, so there are two things that can already be gone, and each is asked of its own owner: jj may hold no workspace of the record's name, and the directory may not be there, and nothing in the registry could have made jj keep a workspace (vuopwuyo). A drifted draft — an open record whose workspace is gone — is the first absence, and it is still an open draft (vuopwuyo, tvxspkyy). Ending it is a discard like any other (tvxspkyy), so the discard proceeds: the seam's Unknown says nothing was forgotten, and the removal of a directory that is not there has nothing to remove. This is not the silent success the seam refuses to report: the seam's outcome still distinguishes a workspace that was dropped from one that was never there (tyoypkmp). Nor does the tolerance reach past the draft: it creates no workspace to make the reference true, names no directory but the derived one, and rewrites no record.

That tolerance is not a reconcile repair, and this node repairs nothing. Reconcile reads the registry against jj's workspaces and reports the difference; it never repairs, rewrites, drops or forgets the record, and a drifted open record stays open and still names the workspace (vuopwuyo). A discard is a different act: it ends the draft (tvxspkyy), and its workspace half is the forget and the removal above. Its workspace half reaches no record at all: it rewrites none, and it is not making the record agree with jj; what becomes of the record document, the path it leaves from, the scan that finds the remaining records and the retention of every other record are the store's removal, recorded elsewhere and taken here as given (tvxspkyy). The report of drift and the end of the draft are therefore not rivals and not substitutes: reconcile leaves a drifted record standing and a discard ends it, with reconcile's rule untouched here (vuopwuyo).

These clauses are one commitment, not several. Take away the forget and jj is left holding a workspace for a draft nothing else holds open, and the working copy outlives the draft it was made for; take away the directory removal and a whole working copy of the repository survives at a path no record will be read for again; take away the tolerance and a draft whose workspace is already gone could not be ended, which contradicts a drifted draft being discarded like any other (tvxspkyy). Each of the three is a way the same end would be left half done, and the order is forced by the ownership that makes the forget the removal of the workspace and the directory removal the clearing of what the workspace held (vuopwuyo, xqzstoyo). A forget rule decided apart from the directory rule would leave one of the two behind; either decided apart from the tolerance would make the end conditional on a state the registry cannot control; and the tolerance decided apart from both would be an absence with nothing to be absent from.

Not settled here. What becomes of the record document is the store's removal — the one document, its path, the scan that discovers the remaining records, and the retention of every other record — recorded elsewhere and neither restated nor changed (tvxspkyy). What becomes of the change the draft's workspace holds is another commitment, decided elsewhere. The verb surface is another: the command, its name, flags, arguments, output, refusal wording and exit status, including how a failure of the seam or of the removal reaches the user, are not decided here. The exact jj invocation behind the forget is the seam's (tyoypkmp), the workspace's creation and its jj name are taken as they stand (tyoypkmp, xqzstoyo), and what reconcile reports and refuses to repair stays vuopwuyo's. This node adds only the workspace half of a discard: forget it through the seam, remove the directory the handle derives, and carry the same discard through when either is already gone.
content.rationale:
This decision is prose because the commitment is what the end of a draft does to the workspace it was written in, and every prerequisite it leans on decides that world in prose or in a seam named by prose: the end of an open draft without landing (tvxspkyy), the place a draft's working copy lives and the reference the record keeps to it (xqzstoyo), the three jj crossings the workspace module owns and how an unknown name is carried (tyoypkmp), and the ownership split that makes jj the owner of existence while the registry owns meaning (vuopwuyo). Nothing in it needs a behavior probe; a reviewer reads the clauses against those four nodes.

The three parts are one answer. Forgetting the workspace, removing the directory the handle derives, and carrying the same discard through when either is already gone are not three rules: they are the one end applied to a draft's two-sided workspace — jj's registration, and the tree the registration names. Forgetting without clearing the directory leaves a whole working copy of the repository at a path nothing will name again; clearing the directory without forgetting leaves jj holding a workspace for a draft nothing holds; and either unconditional on presence would make the end conditional on a state the registry cannot control, since jj owns whether a workspace exists and nothing in the registry can make jj keep one (vuopwuyo). The order is part of the same answer: the forget removes the workspace, and only then is the tree that the workspace held a tree no workspace holds, so the removal cannot strip a working copy out from under jj's claim. Neither crossing writes the registry or the graph, so the only registry change a discard makes remains the record's removal (tvxspkyy).

The tolerance is not reconcile. Reconcile reports drift and never repairs it, and a drifted open record stays open and still names the workspace (vuopwuyo); tvxspkyy already says that ending a drifted draft is a discard like any other. This node makes that true for the workspace half by tolerating absence at the two crossings of the same end, and it does so without touching the record: what becomes of the record document is the store's removal, held here as given (tvxspkyy). The tolerance is not a silent success either — the seam carries an unknown name as Unknown with nothing removed (tyoypkmp), so the discard proceeds knowing the difference between a workspace it dropped and one that was never there.

Deliberately not here: the store's removal of the record document (path, scan, retention), the change the workspace holds, the verb surface including output and exit status, and the exact jj invocation and flags behind the forget. Each can be decided, changed or dropped without moving what this node settles, and each belongs to a commitment recorded or planned elsewhere. The path derivation, the creation of a workspace and the jj name are taken as the seam and its own node state them (xqzstoyo, tyoypkmp).
